body:
Solace's server (`solace serve`) uses a large share of one processor core even when no agent is working. Measured on WSL2:

- 44–47% of a core with nothing happening: 318 minutes of processor time over 11 hours, on 10 threads.
- 60% of a core with one planning conversation waiting for the human.

The cause isn't known yet. Candidates: wait loops that check every 50 ms (`board::runs.wait_reply`), the file watcher, and the app's live-update stream.

Done when an idle server, and one with a conversation waiting for the human, uses close to no processor time. The summary names what was causing it.
title: server: no busy processor while idle
